tang-china.lineage_notes_sid: A cosmopolitan capital at the eastern end of the Silk Road, where monastic communities, merchant caravans, and farming villages meet along the Wei River valley.

peasant.description_sid: You work a small holding of rented land along the Wei River, its seasons setting the rhythm of every day.

merchant.description_sid: You move goods between the Western Market and the caravan depots, bargaining in three languages before noon.

monastic.description_sid: You live in the workshops of a monastery precinct, keeping the storehouses and greeting travelers at the gate.

bardo.no_echoes_sid: No echoes were detected. The next life begins unburdened.
bardo.next_life_empty_sid: No further lives are available in this chain.

echo.pattern_break_sid: A long-held pattern broke open: care returned after aversion.

about.disclaimer_body_sid: Yakshetra is a work of fiction inspired by Buddhist ethical and contemplative traditions. It does not represent itself as doctrine, nor as a teaching of any lineage, teacher, or school. The parami-inspired lenses, the cross-life echoes, and the narrative situations are game design choices made in good faith, not claims about how the world actually works. If a theme here is difficult for you, the content-warning settings let you step away from it.
about.lineage_body_sid: The game draws loosely on the six parami framework found across Theravada and Mahayana ethical literature, and on narrative conventions common to historical and fantasy fiction. No specific living teacher, order, or institution endorses or is represented by this work. Full lineage notes will accompany each era pack when the packs ship.

glossary.parami_definition_sid: A quality cultivated through practice. The game's six lenses are named for parami-inspired qualities.
glossary.lens_definition_sid: The frame a player focuses a choice through. Each lens is named for a parami-inspired quality.
glossary.intent_root_definition_sid: The root an action springs from: care, greed, aversion, or delusion. Drives the cross-life echoes.
glossary.karmic_echo_definition_sid: A narrative thread carried from one life into the next. Echoes add context and shift event availability; they are never a score.
glossary.bardo_definition_sid: An 'in-between' state. The game's between-lives screen is functional UI, not a depiction of any doctrinal bardo.
glossary.life_chain_definition_sid: A sequence of two lives the player moves through, beginning unburdened and closing on a chain-complete screen.
glossary.era_pack_definition_sid: A data pack defining one setting: its events, roles, glossary, and rule variation.
glossary.rule_variation_definition_sid: An era-specific social mechanic layered onto the engine without era-specific code branching.
glossary.narrative_seed_definition_sid: An event or beat injected into the next life by an echo, surfacing what carried forward.
glossary.content_warning_definition_sid: A category a player may toggle off to filter the corresponding events out of the pool.
glossary.social_identity_definition_sid: Opaque descriptive attributes of a life. Never aggregated into a score; never carried forward by echoes.

death-of-family.description_sid: The death of a family member or close relation.

illness-chronic-suffering.description_sid: Disease, injury, or sustained bodily suffering.

war-political-violence.description_sid: Armed conflict, occupation, or organized political violence.

betrayal.description_sid: A trusted person breaking a serious bond of trust.

social-oppression.description_sid: Coercive social hierarchies, caste, or institutional exclusion.

forced-moral-compromise.description_sid: Situations with no clean choice, where any path entails some harm.

separation-from-loved-ones.description_sid: Involuntary parting from family or close bonds.

default.journal_sid: The moment passes, carrying its weight forward into what comes next.

grain-requisition.label_sid: A bailiff from the county seat stands at the gate, scroll in hand. The magistrate requires a portion of stored grain for the army of the western frontier. The neighbors have already begun to comply; the road is loud with carts.

comply.hint_sid: You give what is asked without delay. The scroll is marked satisfied, the bailiff bows, and the household eats thinner through the rest of the season.

hide_some.label_sid: Hide a portion in the back of the storehouse
hide_some.hint_sid: You bury sacks beneath the millet and show the bailiff only part of what you have. The neighbors’ glances when he leaves are not what they were before.

petition.label_sid: Walk to the county seat and petition for relief
petition.hint_sid: A petition buys time, sometimes grain returned, sometimes nothing. You will lose a day in the road dust and the magistrate may remember your name for it.

sick-traveler.label_sid: On the road outside the village, a traveler sits under a persimmon tree, forehead burning and lips dry. They look up but cannot rise.

take_in.label_sid: Bring them in and tend to them
take_in.hint_sid: You give your time and your strength to someone whose name you may never know. Other travelers, hearing of it, may one day look for your gate.

pass_by.hint_sid: You are not unkind; you are simply occupied. The persimmon tree is a fine shelter, you tell yourself, and there is work waiting.

send_for_lay_brother.label_sid: Send for the lay-brother who keeps the monastery gate
send_for_lay_brother.hint_sid: You cannot tend a stranger yourself today, but you can fetch someone who might. A day is spent on the errand; the gate-keeper knows your name now.

corrupt-donation-demand.label_sid: An older monastic in the precinct sends word: a substantial gift would “open the door to advancement” within the community. The framing is careful; the request is not.

give.hint_sid: You hand over the coin. The framing of “accumulating merit” sits uneasy — this game does not award such a thing; what remains is the gesture, the loss, and the question it left behind.

refuse_politely.label_sid: Decline politely, with a small bow
refuse_politely.hint_sid: You refuse without accusation. The door does not close, but the warmth behind it cools a degree. You are still welcome in the courtyard; you are no longer invited into the inner rooms.

report_to_officials.label_sid: Carry the matter to the county officials
report_to_officials.hint_sid: An honest thing to do, and a costly one. The monastic community will not soon forget your name; the officials will note your reliability in other, less kind, files.

conscripted-brother.label_sid: A labor levy summons your brother to the frontier roadworks. He is not strong, and the roadworks are not kind.

help_flee.label_sid: Help him slip away before the caravan leaves
help_flee.hint_sid: You will lose the goodwill of whoever keeps the conscription roll, and you may gain something harder to name. Your brother will remember the night you came for him.

let_go.hint_sid: You watch the cart leave. The household is one quieter, the magistrate one less suspicious. The family will speak of this in years to come, and not all of them gently.

pay_bribe.label_sid: Pay the levy officer to strike his name from the list
pay_bribe.hint_sid: Three strings of coin in the officer’s sleeve and your brother’s name is written over. It is done; it is also done.

famine-year.label_sid: The autumn harvest is thin, and the winter ahead is thinner. Provisions in the bin are less than you would wish and less than your neighbors will need.

share.label_sid: Share what you have with the neighbors
share.hint_sid: You set aside half of what is in the bin and carry it door to door. By spring, you may eat thin porridge. By spring, your neighbors are still alive.

hoard.hint_sid: You nail the bin shut and answer the door less often. The provisions last; the goodwill does not. You will eat in winter; you will eat alone.

seek_monastery_granary.label_sid: Walk to the monastery granary and ask
seek_monastery_granary.hint_sid: A long walk. The granary is not empty, but it is not generous to those it does not know. Time is lost; perhaps a portion is returned.

persecution-edict.label_sid: An imperial order comes down the road. Monastics are to be defrocked, statues broken, wandering monks returned to lay status. The order is written in the careful hand of someone who has never read a sutra.

hide_monk.label_sid: Hide a wandering monk who came to your gate last night
hide_monk.hint_sid: You take them in. You know the cost of being caught, and you know the cost of refusing. They will sleep in your back room until the order is lifted or until your name is written on a list.

comply_and_report.label_sid: Carry the order out, and report any who have not yet complied
comply_and_report.hint_sid: You walk the road with the constables. The monastic community that once knew your name now knows it differently.

flee_region.label_sid: Take what can be carried and leave the region
flee_region.hint_sid: The road is open in any direction. The household you leave is not your household; the one you reach is not yet home. The persecution continues elsewhere, and you have made sure it does not include you.

child-illness.label_sid: Your child has not woken cleanly in three days. The fever is high and the breathing is thin.

spend_all_wealth.label_sid: Spend everything you have on a physician
spend_all_wealth.hint_sid: You empty the purse for the doctor at the gate. Whether it is enough is not yours to know. The household afterwards is a household with thin walls.

pray_and_wait.hint_sid: You sit beside the bed. The incense burns. The fever will do what fevers do, and the household will remember whichever way it goes.

seek_chan_master.label_sid: Seek counsel of a Chan master at the nearby monastery
seek_chan_master.hint_sid: A day on the road, an afternoon in the monastery, an evening of questions without easy answers. What you bring back is not a cure. What you bring back is something the household can stand inside of.

card.corrupt-donation-demand-give-commodifica: The older monastic smiled as the coin changed hands. The teaching spoke of accumulating merit; this game does not award merit. What was given was given; what remains is the gesture, the lighter purse, and the question it left behind.

action.give_alms_label_sid: Give alms at the temple gate

consequence.alms_given_sid: The beggar ate well; your bowl came back lighter.

journal.alms_memory_sid: A handful of rice, passed from one open hand to another, carried into the next dawn.
